name: Irekawa Onee-chan, Boku no Karada de Onani Shichau no!?
original_name: いれかわ　お姉ちゃん、ぼくの身体でオナニーしちゃうの!?
source:
Segawa Yoshiki is a young boy who doesn't get along with his step-sister Eriko. One day, she bumped into him and they swapped their bodies. 
What will happen to both of them?
translation:
